items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: When we got down in Birmingham, Alabama, I think I quit...I quit this show. I went with the Clarence Muse Show.

ctx.x: Well, the minstrel performers... We had a stage. And the band would be right in front of the stage, down on the floor. They had a platform on there, but not as high as the stage -- a platform for the band. Sometimes they'd have a piano, and sometimes they just used a banjo in place of the piano. But mostly they used a piano, because they had a lot...they had a girl singer. A girl singer, you know, she had to sing behind the piano. I didn't know anything about singing then. I used to listen to the way other people…
When we got down in Birmingham, Alabama, I think I quit...I quit this show. I went with the Clarence Muse Show.
